title: Santa Threepio
description: SANTA THREEPIO and an antlered Artoo-Detoo (front) cozy up before the fireplace to send Lucasfilm's Christmas greetings in this card, one of a series painted over five years by Ralph McQuarrie. Santa Yoda (back by McQuarie), seems loaded down with toys for all little Jedi. The back of the card has a painting of Santa Yoda's back. Cards and other limited-run Lucasfilm items tied to the STAR WARS trilogy are a collector's dream.
